lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior branchial region towards the caudal peduncle, with spot diameter and inter-centroid spacing increasing posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible, characterized by high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed ventral edges, running horizontally along the upper and mid-flank.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small-scale high-luminance points visible across the entire surface of the pectoral fin and the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
